text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release v2.14.0 -> inference-api. Canary hosts: canary-3, canary-4. trigger: manual by @sophie.

oncall-bot: ALERT INC-2026-121: elevated tail latency observed in eu-west1 for inference-api. p99 spiked to ~1.2s at 2026-03-19T21:02Z. Severity: P1.

sophie (Release Lead): Pause the rollout. everyone hold on promotions.

raj (SRE): Copy. I'm looking at traces. Is this only on canary hosts or across cluster?

maria (Eng Runtime): Metrics show the spike correlates with canary-3 and canary-4 after the new kernel/kv-change shipped in v2.14.0. Non-canary nodes look normal so far.

james (Deploy): Deploy-bot: abort further canary promotions and stop shift traffic. Also queue rollback on canary nodes.

deploy-bot: Canary promotions halted. Further promotions aborted. Rollback job queued for canary hosts: canary-3, canary-4.

kevin (Infra): I'm seeing increased KV cache misses tied to a routing change in the new runtime. Reverting that change should be straightforward but will take ~60-90m to validate.

release-manager: We should pin the public release pointer to v2.13.5 for now and update internal release notes + customer comms. Sophie, want me to draft a short note?

sophie (Release Lead): Yes, pin the pointer and mark v2.14.0 as "on hold - incident investigation". RM, please draft comms for affected enterprise customers and update the release board.

raj (SRE): Given it's isolated to canaries, prefer rollback on those hosts first rather than cluster-wide rollback. If rollback doesn't normalize p99 within 15m, escalate to full rollback.

maria (Eng Runtime): I'll open a hotfix PR to revert the KV routing tweak and add a test for the misrouting case. Pushing now.

james (Deploy): Executing rollback on canary-3 and canary-4 now: 
```
kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-api --to-revision=revision-v2.13.5 -n eu-west1
```

deploy-bot: Rollback started on canary-3 and canary-4. Jobs: job-2981, job-2982.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-121 updated: rollback in progress, monitoring for normalization.

kevin (Infra): Revert PR merged, running integration smoke. Expect safe to promote in ~90m if metrics good.

release-manager: Set new tentative change window to tomorrow 03:00 UTC for a retry; marking as pending until ops gives green. Will prepare release notes with a clear rollback and test plan.

sophie (Release Lead): Agreed. Reschedule to tomorrow 03:00 UTC change window. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre for postmortem follow-up. @maria please add the test to the eval suite and @raj please coordinate the SLO checks.

maria (Eng Runtime): Added unit + integration tests to catch KV routing regressions. Also adding a perf gate to the CI job.

raj (SRE): I'll add an alert rule to detect sudden tail latency regressions tied to kv miss rate.

james (Deploy): Notifying QA to run the canary smoke after rollback completes.

release-manager: Drafted customer note: "We halted a deployment to investigate increased latency affecting a small subset of canary hosts. No customer-facing data was impacted. A rollback was performed and further rollout will be rescheduled after verification." Will circulate for review.

sophie (Release Lead): Thanks. Once SRE confirms normalized metrics and infra signs off, we'll re-open the release and use a cautious canary (1 host) then ramp slowly. If anything flares, immediate rollback.

maria (Eng Runtime): Metrics look back to baseline on the two canaries after rollback. p99 ~210-240ms. I'll keep monitoring.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-121: status=mitigated. Next steps: postmortem + test backfill + reschedule.

raj (SRE): I'll own the postmortem. Adding immediate action items to the incident doc.

kevin (Infra): Ops validated revert. Green across eu-west1.

sophie (Release Lead): Great. Reschedule to tomorrow 03:00 UTC as planned. Release marked "reschedule: 2026-03-20T03:00Z" and pointer pinned to v2.13.5. Closing thread; reopen if we see any regression. :white_check_mark:

james (Deploy): Thanks all. Good catch and quick rollback.

release-manager: I'll send the customer comms and update the release board now.

maria (Eng Runtime): Filing a follow-up RFC for safer KV routing rollouts.

sophie (Release Lead): End of thread.
